Recorded claim:
`calImipBar.getButtons()` returns XUL `toolbarbutton`s in `#imip-view-toolbar`, not HTML buttons. Hidden and disabled controls are already excluded from sequential focus, so dynamic `tabindex="-1"` handling is unnecessary; static `tabindex="0"` is sufficient. [Task 1]
